commit_message: Fix manual report workflow startup permissions
pr_body:
Closes #96

## Summary

Hardens the two manual report workflows after the dashboard validation run failed at startup before any job or artefact was created.

## Changes

- Updates `.github/workflows/generate-issue-dashboard.yml` to use the conservative `permissions: read-all` shorthand.
- Updates `.github/workflows/check-issue-hygiene.yml` to use the same conservative read-only permission shape.
- Keeps both workflows manually triggered, report-only, and non-mutating.

## Validation

- `git apply --check /tmp/issue96.diff` on the exact unified diff in a clean temporary git worktree.
- Workflow YAML and command paths reviewed.
- Runtime workflow validation still needs to be repeated after merge by rerunning #91 and then #93.
